Текущий шаг: Workflow step and task context

Инструкции:
  - Your first working operation is terminal -> project-workflow --json step --task <workflow-task-key> --operation-key <original-key> --runtime-request <private-request-json> --execution-token-file <private-token-file> without --report. Use only the supplied namespace, assignment/run fence and report=null request. Verify the admitted returned Workflow step before any Tracker read, dialogue, file edit or CI/CD action. Tracker task UUID equals root UUID; the Workflow key is its local session mapping. An installed profile is not execution admission: pending API registration or authorization is a blocker. Never downgrade to human CLI/local DB mode or modify native Hermes. Используй навыки: project-workflow-executor, tracker-operator.
  - After the Workflow step, read task-tracker sdlc context --task <task-uuid>, task-tracker sdlc requirements --task <task-uuid> and task-tracker sdlc questions --task <task-uuid> with the authorized task identity. Read all available comments and attachments using permitted existing task-tracker comment list <issue-id> and task-tracker attachment list --issue <issue-id>; follow attachment references only with authorized access. Missing required input/access is an explicit blocker. Verify the same task UUID, approved revision/hash, assigned role/mode, current stage/status and predecessor evidence. An absent requirements revision is normal only while PM creates the first Draft. Используй навыки: project-workflow-executor, tracker-operator.
  - This preset works on ONE Tracker task throughout. Never create children, decomposition cards, parent/dependency links for a delivery DAG, aggregate work or integration barriers. Do not activate integration or integration_rework modes. The Architect mode key decomposition means architecture and an implementation plan inside this task only. Stages are Draft, Backlog, Analysis, Architecture, Development, Review, Testing, Rework, Deployment. Status is separately Ready, InProgress or Completed; waiting_reason and runtime/agent state are separate observations, never substitute statuses. Only a real Tracker receipt establishes a business transition; do not set InProgress yourself on startup. Use the ordinary terminal with project-workflow, task-tracker and cicd-cli as actually installed and authorized. Do not modify original Hermes, install skills or infer capabilities from their names. Existing skill names are references, not authorization to execute legacy multi-task instructions. Используй навыки: project-workflow-executor, tracker-operator.
  - Report only this completed preparation phase via terminal -> project-workflow --json step --task <workflow-task-key> --report <report-text> with the supplied --operation-key, --runtime-request and --execution-token-file. body.report must equal --report; retain exact key/body for uncertain-effect readback. Stop at the returned next phase: owner confirmation belongs to phase 3 in this SAME execution. Do not complete the PM Workflow or create another assignment/cycle to wait for consent. Используй навыки: project-workflow-executor, tracker-operator.

Чекапы:
  - The returned Workflow step is admitted in the assigned namespace.
  - The one Tracker task, current stage/status and input references match.

Доказательства:
  - Actual first Workflow step response and task/input references.
